description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to 'likes' on shares within the OrangeHRM Buzz module. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes specific filtering criteria such as share ID and sorting options.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for setting filter parameters to search for 'likes' on shares, including allowed sort fields and share ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter with a default sort field ('shareLike.likedAtUtc').

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the share ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the share ID filter criterion.
